🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin opens Q4 stuck near $84K as stubborn bond yields cap a soft-inflation bounce. Wall Street keeps building — Citi turns bullish, Open USD goes live — but September's record hack losses show security still lags adoption. 📊 Bitcoin Starts Q4 Stuck in the $82K–$85K Range as Yields Cap PCE Bounce Bitcoin began the fourth quarter where it ended the third: boxed between $82,000 and $85,000. A softer-than-expected U.S. PCE inflation reading briefly lifted BTC above $85,000 and trimmed October rate-hike bets, but the move faded as long-dated Treasury yields stayed elevated, with the 30-year topping 5.6%. Spot bitcoin ETFs added pressure with $148.7M in net outflows on Sept. 30, ending a nine-session inflow streak, even though BTC closed Q3 up roughly 40%. Read full story 🏦 Citigroup Lifts 12-Month Bitcoin Target to $113,000 Citigroup raised its 12-month bitcoin forecast to $113,000 from $82,000 and its ether target to $3,028 from $2,240, according to a client note reported by Reuters. The bank expects about $5 billion of crypto inflows over the next year as advisers and brokerages gradually build allocations, pointing to returning ETF demand, a supportive macro backdrop and U.S. Treasury long-bond buybacks. The new BTC target sits roughly 35% above spot, yet still below the October 2025 record above $126,000. More details 💵 Open USD Stablecoin Goes Live With Stripe, Visa, Mastercard and Coinbase Open Standard's dollar stablecoin, Open USD (OUSD), is now live on Ethereum, Solana, Base and Tempo. It is issued by Stripe-owned Bridge, with reserves held at BlackRock, BNY and Lead Bank and monthly attestations promised, while founding partners Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa have committed more than $1 billion to seed supply. Businesses can mint and redeem 1:1 at no cost, with Coinbase access opening October 1 — a direct challenge to USDT and USDC. Steve Daines (R-Mont.) introduced the 56-page ADAPT Act, arriving two weeks after the House Ways and Means Committee advanced its own crypto tax bill 38–5. 80057.subject: 📈 Cool inflation pumps markets
80057.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $83,893 (-0.0%) | **ETH** $2,706 (0.3%) | **SOL** $118 (-1.3%)

* US core PCE rises [0.2%](https://x.com/wallstengine/status/2105274235442663709) in August, cooler than the 0.3% estimate

* US 10-year Treasury yield hits [5.304%](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2105349582188388607), highest since May 2002

* ZachXBT says North Korean attackers shielded [2,700 ZEC](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2105244473051734231), worth $3.8M, into Ironwood pool

* Bitcoin gains [43%](https://cryptoslate.com/bitcoin-enters-its-best-season-after-a-43-surge-with-147000-suddenly-on-the-math/) in Q3, its strongest quarter since 2024, as ETF inflows turn positive by $6B

* Open Standard launches [OUSD](https://x.com/solidintel_x/status/2105317871182360898), a yield-sharing stablecoin backed by Stripe, Visa and Mastercard

* Google unveils [Gemini 4 Argon](https://x.com/BusinessInsider/status/2105388530797093173), calling it its most powerful AI model yet — Rumors surface that [actual performance](https://x.com/kimmonismus/status/2105570914574209283) doesn’t match up to benchmarks

* Base launches its [Cobalt upgrade](https://cryptobriefing.com/cobalt-base-mainnet-engineering-improvements/) on mainnet, adding conditional transactions and B20 asset functions

* OpenAI and Synopsys announce a multi-year deal to build [GPT-Synopsys](https://x.com/DeItaone/status/2105364721029538175), a chip design AI model

* Metaplex opens more seats on the [Vantage beta](https://x.com/metaplex/status/2105331343685279773)

* Coinbase opens Anthropic [pre-IPO perps ](https://x.com/CoinbaseMarkets/status/2105589323819110496)for eligible non-US users

* A wallet linked to Joseph Lubin moves [133,298 ETH](https://x.com/lookonchain/status/2105472273151123537), worth about $356 million

* Sen. Steve Daines introduces a Senate bill to modernize [crypto tax rules](https://cryptobriefing.com/senate-republicans-introduce-crypto-tax-bill-targeting-digital-assets/)

* DogeOS launches a public testnet bringing [EVM smart contracts](https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2105359920795394451) to Dogecoin

———————————————————————————
